description.content: Found on a shelf inside the building with a blue facia, and a beer barrel hanging outside. Only accessible after lowering the water level during the Side Mission, "Oblivion".
Found by interacting with the Fiz vending machine on the lower level of the flooded sector. Only accessible after lowering the water level during the Side Mission, "Oblivion".

On the east side of the Construction Zone, look for a blinking yellow light by a wooden ramp near the elevator shaft. Climb up and into the building above. Climb up again to the floor above using the hole in the southeast corner of the ceiling. The can is on a workbench by a red toolbox.
Interact with the Fiz vending machine to have the can drop out of the bottom.
Interact with the Fiz vending machine above Sisters' Junk to have the can drop out of the bottom.
Between the waypoint and the bulletin board is an alleyway with this can at the end of it.
Found on the ground when heading to the Bulletin Board.
In an alleyway that leads to The Last Gulp (where Su and Enya are) there's a Fiz machine on the left.
At the far end of the northern plaza with the large planet sculpture in the centre, in the far right corner (to the right of Delloih), up some stairs, there is a Fiz machine.
To the left of the Delloih place, outside a window display with mannequins and near a skateboard.
Take the rope and then ladder down to the bottom, then jump to the rocks behind the Legion Supply Box.

Turn on 2 consoles in the area north of the Solar Tower, then push the yellow box to the shipping container in the middle of the area to turn on the final console. The chest next to it will open, which has this can inside.

On the eastern side of the Barren Land area there are two paths leading to the Scrap Plains. Take the southeast path. As you go, look for a vending machine on the left side of the path. Interact with it to get this can.

Take the path up to the north from the Solar Tower and bend round to the east, when you drop down (while still heading east), where the Racer's High Nano Suit was, you're actually going to want to drop down to the south, and then platform the way along a few cliffs and up a lot of them too. There's only one way to go, so stick on the path and you'll be at the ladder and the can in no time.
Go through the Wrecked Ship to reach the cliff's edge and then turn left to find this can at the end.
In the southwestern edge west of the nearby Supply Camp. Roll the two balls onto the switches beside the cooler box. The second ball is found in the cliffside corner to the left of the switches.

At the northern end of the narrow gorge that creates an 'X' shape, there is a Tetrastar Chest. Open the chest and a drone with a target will pop out. Shoot it and it will move to another location. Shoot the target again after it stops in the middle of the canyon, then shoot it one final time at the south end of the canyon to get it to drop the Can.

The Can is behind a locked gate accessible by climbing above the path to the east of the entrance to Altess Levoire, then jumping down the poles and ledges in the western corner of these clifftops. Solve the pressure plate puzzle by putting all 3 carts on the left pressure plate so it reads 23 on the left and 03 on the right, matching the sign above it. Jump down the hatch in front of the numbers to get the Can.

Now that you have Double Jump, fast-travel to the Western Great Canyon Supply Camp and head north, and climb the cliffs to the north. Keep running, jumping and climbing until you reach the top. There's an ice chest with this can in it.
Next to the Central Great Canyon Camp is a billboard. Pull over the yellow box from the north to the steel girder. Double jump up and walk across the billboard for this can.
Found in a crate on top of a lift platform on the western edge of the Northern Scrap Plains. Activate the lever to the north to lower the platform, then sprint back to the lift to reach it.

Walk to the edge of the cliff here and pulse your scanner. Over the edge, you'll see three metal beams under a piece of scrap, and a droid trapped inside. Shoot the beams to release the droid, and it will drop the can for you.

Above the Waypoint near the Bulletin Board, you will find a collection of buildings constructed out of scrap. Use the metal ramp on the left side to jump up and across to the Can's location. You need Double Jump to reach it.
Found inside a Fiz vending machine next to a small concrete ruin on the cliff edge.

Located inside a chest that will drop to the floor after completing the trolley puzzle. Place three trolleys on their respective panel to drop the crate. One trolley is on the metal platform to the right, the second is to the left of the entrance by the stairs, and the last is on the upper platform at the back.

Located halfway down the Forbidden Area behind the gate and fence. Go down the first two ropes and look to the west to find the gate and fence. Now, use the rubble around the edge to reach the gate, open it, and pick up the can.
Next to two blue shipping containers by the raised section of track on the southwest side of the Rail Yard.
In a hidden room behind the burning tires on the west side of the Juggernaut fight arena. Go under the metal staircase behind the shipping containers to find it.
Found on a small platform at the north end of the flooded tunnel, past the submerged train and the chain link fence. There is a hole in the fence, underwater, that you can swim through.

Open the chest located on top of the mountain to obtain this Can. You can reach this by moving the yellow crate over to the ledges and then climbing up. When you enter this area, a boulder will drop behind you and trap you there until you defeat the enemies.
Right next to the West of Buried Ruins camp. Place a Smart Mine on the shining bit of the ground and wait for the underground Nyatiba to bump into it to dislodge the chest with the Can.
Located in the chest on the small building, under the area you land from the makeshift ramp. Carefully jump between the lasers to reach the chest.
Interact with the vending machine on the ground floor, east of the Crumbling Rooftop Camp. You will be ambushed by two Tentacle and one Lurker Naytibas as you approach it.

To get this one, you need to solve a puzzle to the north of the Opera House. Take out the turret and then put the hover storage on the pressure plates, so that they all equal 4, 6 and 7 (from west to east). Once you've done that and got all greens, open the door to the northeast. Inside is a chest with this can.

To the northeast of the Opera House in the Buried Ruins, you'll find a small parking lot. On the southern wall of the parking lot, you will see the numbers 12, 2 and 13 written. You will need to move the three yellow boxes here into the parking spots labelled 12, 2 and 13. Doing so will unlock the nearby ice camp cooler.

Located in a chest behind the lasers. You can get here by following the path north from the Middle Path between Ruins Camp. Push the yellow block north and place it on the right side of the lasers to block them. Note, you will be ambushed by Creeper and Lurker Naytibas while pushing the yellow block.

Behind the locked gate near the Middle Path between Ruins camp. Climb the scaffolding located across the Opera House, then move the yellow crate to under the yellow ledge in the back to access the area containing a chest with a Can inside.
Near the Exile's Passage camp. Shoot the box sticking out of the ground to reveal this can.
Located inside the chest on the platform. Climb the ledge lift and jump on the maintenance bots to reach it.
Climb the yellow ledges, shoot the drone target, then swing from the branches to the rope, climb to the top, and reach the chest.

Northeast of the Great Desert Outskirts Supply Camp is an Ice Camp cooler. Interact with it and you'll see 3 targets appear behind the box. Shoot the central target, the right target and then the left target in that order and the box will open, ejecting the can.

Northeast of the Underground Secret Passage Camp, is an Ice Camp cooler on the roof of a building. Interact with it and shoot the explosive barrels before they hit you to unlock this one. Make sure you have plenty of ammo!
South of the Oasis, near a platform with a cable running to it, is a Fiz vending machine with this can.
Found in an Ice Camp cooler on top of the Hypertube. You can climb on to this from the west side of it.

Just northeast of West of Buried Ruins Legion Camp is a mini-game of sorts. First, you need to shoot a floating target to drop a rope. Second, you need to climb up and power the generator. Third, you need to race to the second and third before the time expires. Do that, and you'll open the garage door below where you end up, which has a can inside.

Behind the first camp you come to after the first fight with Belial, you'll see some pipes jutting out of the wall. Jump onto these pipes and use them to cross to the walkway behind the camp. Follow this walkway around the room and you'll reach a long pathway. At the end of this pathway is the can.
Once you reach the Space Logistics Center Supply Camp, look on the opposite side of this room behind some shipping containers.

After entering the Raphael Space Center, you will see an information booth ahead. Over to the right is the door that we want to head through to continue. However, if you attempt to do so you will find that it is currently locked. Check the seating area to the left of the locked door, and look around behind the seats to find this can.

After climbing along the outer wall and coming back inside, defeat the enemies and the Machine Hive. Head over to the gap in the window the Machine Hive had been blocking. Rather than going across the girder here, look to the right. You should be able to spot another section of the walkway to which we can jump. Do so and follow it to the end where there will be a Fiz vending machine with the can inside. Note: If you miss this one, you can fish it up from the Oasis in the Great Desert using Strange Bait after finishing Spire 4.
